newsitem.title: THAILAND: Banharn names new caretaker cabinet ministers.
newsitem.headline: Banharn names new caretaker cabinet ministers.

text.p: Outgoing Prime Minister Banharn Silpa-archa on Friday appointed seven active and retired civil servants as caretaker cabinet ministers just hours before he surprised the country by calling snap general elections.

Radio Thailand said Banharn named former foreign minister Kasem S. Kasemsri as a deputy prime minister, and chose General Viroj Saengsanit, his close ally and retiring military supreme commander, as deputy defence minsiter.

Deputy central bank governor Chaiyawat Wibulswasdi was appointed acting deputy finance minister, and former agriculture minister Kosit Panpiemrat was named to head the Industry Ministry in the run-up to the November 17 poll.

Other appointments were caretaker deputy ministers for commerce, foreign affairs and interior, which had been left vacant following the July pullout of the Palang Dharma Party, Banharn's junior coalition partner.
"These new appointees will oversee respective ministries only for two months during the transition period," Deputy Prime Minister Amnuay Viravan told reporters.
